Whether you are a professional pilot, a student in training, or an aviation enthusiast, this app effortlessly answers all of your aviation definition needs. Can’t remember what that code means on your METAR, or wondering what that abbreviation is in your NOTAMs or Flight Plan, well Pilot's Toolkit - Aviation Dictionary will answer all of that and more.

Filtered by states such as FAA, EASA, ICAO and more, any term you can think of will be presented to you in a detailed format. Have a thirst for knowledge well this is covered too as this app will allow you to search for further information on Google or Wikipedia tailored for all of the terms.

Features include:
- Offline search for all aviation related terms
- Definitions filtered by state (FAA, EASA, CASA, ICAO)
- Includes all NOTAM, MET, AIP Definitions and Abbreviations
- Automatic Dark Mode enabled for night flying
- Portrait and Landscape modes for pivot mounted iPads in the flight deck
- Further information available by accessing Google or Wikipedia

The terms and definitions are 100% offline. This app includes a database built in that includes over 7000 definitions and abbreviations. The ability to search for further information does require an internet connection however this is only used if you need further information than that already delivered by the app.
